title: 학교 급식 식단표 읽기: 무슨 요일에 뭐가 나와요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean school lunch menu (급식 식단표) and find what is served on each day, which days have no lunch, and which dishes contain a given allergy food.
summary: Learners read a weekly Korean school lunch menu and find dishes, days, and allergy information.
note: This menu is a made-up example for study. It is not a real school's menu.

task.title: Find information in the menu
task.line: Use the 한빛초등학교 menu on page 1 to answer each question.

sections.heading: 자료: 한빛초등학교 10월 셋째 주 급식 식단표
paragraphs: 10월 21일(수) | 잡곡밥, 된장찌개(5.6), 고등어구이(7), 시금치나물(5), 배추김치(9), 요구르트(2)
※ 식단은 식재료 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다.

items.text: The lunch the school gives to students.
A table that shows the food for each day.
Rice cooked with beans and other grains.
The soup served with rice in the meal.
Small dishes eaten with rice, such as fish or vegetables.
Fruit or a sweet food after the meal.
Foods that can cause an allergy; each one has a number.
items.example: 아이가 땅콩을 못 먹어서 알레르기 유발 식품 번호를 꼭 봐요.

items.text: The allergy-list word for eggs of any kind.
items.example: 난류는 달걀이나 메추리알 같은 알을 말해요.

items.text: The day the school was founded; there are no classes, so there is no lunch.
items.example: 다음 주 금요일은 개교기념일이라서 학교에 안 가요.

items.text: The menu on the table is a plan, not a promise.
items.example: 날씨 때문에 행사 날짜가 변경될 수 있습니다.

sections.heading: 식단표 읽는 법
paragraphs: Read the date and the day in brackets first: (월) Mon, (화) Tue, (수) Wed, (목) Thu, (금) Fri. A day marked 급식 없음 (no school lunch) means the school does not serve lunch that day.
The small numbers after a dish, like 달걀국(1.5), are allergy numbers. Find your number in the ※ line at the bottom. A dish with no number, like 사과, has none of the listed foods.

exercises: Find the information: 짜장면은 무슨 요일에 나와요?
True (O) or false (X)? ① 10월 23일에도 학교에서 점심을 먹어요. ② 화요일 후식은 사과예요.
Situation: 민수는 달걀 알레르기가 있어요. On which two days should 민수 be careful? Write the days in Korean.
Choose the right word: 고등어구이는 (국 / 반찬 / 후식)이에요.
Situation: 지아는 우유를 마시면 배가 아파요. On which days does lunch have allergy number 2? Write all the days in Korean.
Fill in the blank: 10월 23일은 ____이라서 급식이 없어요.
